Ravi (docs): quick sync: we need a short migration note for v1 -> v2 focusing on model swaps and SDK param rename. goal: single-page guide + two tiny snippets. Public notice Aug 5.

Sasha (sdk): I'll draft JS + python examples that show old param -> new param and recommend pinning model@date. keep it copy-paste.

Ivy (prod): add a fallback section: if model@version missing, route to alias and emit metric fallback.model_used. include canary header X-Traffic-Split.

Ravi (docs): include checklist: token counts, embed dims, API scopes. also add a one-liner for Dedicated customers: contact your account rep, we won't auto-migrate.

Sasha (sdk): snippet: // v1 -> v2 map
const v1 = { model: "rwd-core", prompt: "Hi" }
const v2 = { model: `${v1.model}@2024-08-01`, input: v1.prompt }
client.responses.create(v2)
